blocks.text: Pakistan mein hawa ki aaloodgi par qaboo pane ke aam qawaneen aur zawabit Pakistan Environmental Protection Act (PEPA 1997), National Environmental Quality Standards (NEQS; print mein 'Natural'), aur Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act 2012 hain.

blocks.prompt: Pakistan mein hawa ke mayar se mutalliq qawaneen aur zawabit pehchanein.
blocks.explanation: 1997 ka Pakistan Environmental Protection Act, us ke tahat ikhraj aur hawa ke mayar ki ijazat shuda hadein tay karne wale National Environmental Quality Standards, aur 2012 ka Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act jo unhen Punjab mein lagoo aur mazboot karta hai.

items: PEPA 1997; NEQS; Punjab Environmental Protection (Amendment) Act 2012.
